question: Why do experiencer and experienced become clearly distinct here?
premises: Even when arisen in the mere element of difference, contraction is undergone.
This contraction affects the mode of manifestation.
Experiencer and experienced mutually close upon each other.
inference: Therefore experiencer and experienced appear clearly differentiated in this state.
plain_english: Even though it has arisen in the mere element of difference, because it has undergone contraction, the experiencer and the experienced here clearly close in upon each other as distinct.
